qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of the indexes created by the Fan-Out driver in eDirectory?
qa_pairs.output: In the Fan-Out driver, eDirectory creates additional indexes to optimize attribute location, which improves the performance of searches and operations on objects added to the Identity Vault.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which custom indexes are added to eDirectory when the Fan-Out driver is installed?
qa_pairs.output:
The Fan-Out driver adds the following indexes to eDirectory:

| Index Name                      | Attribute Name                | Type  |
|--------------------------------|-------------------------------|-------|
| ASAM_aliases                  | ASAM-aliases                  | Value |
| ASAM_deletePendingsUpTo       | ASAM-deletePendingsUpTo       | Value |
| ASAM_deletesUpTo              | ASAM-deletesUpTo              | Value |
| ASAM_eGroupMembers            | ASAM-eGroupMembers            | Value |
| ASAM_eGroupMembership         | ASAM-eGroupMembership         | Value |
| ASAM_eventsUpTo               | ASAM-eventsUpTo               | Value |
| ASAM_inputGUID                | ASAM-inputGUID                | Value |
| ASAM_inputReference           | ASAM-inputReference           | Value |
| ASAM-NetAddressList           | ASAM-NetAddressList           | Value |
| ASAM_passwordsUpTo            | ASAM-passwordsUpTo            | Value |
| ASAM_platformAssociation      | ASAM-platformAssociation      | Value |
| Country                        | c                             | Value |
| GUID                           | GUID                          | Value |
| Locality                       | l                             | Value |
| Object_Class                   | objectClass                   | Value |
| Organization                   | Organization                  | Value |
| ou                             | ou                            | Value |
| State                          | s                             | Value |
| Tree_Root                      | t                             | Value |

qa_pairs.instruction: What attribute name is associated with the GUID index in the Fan-Out driver?
qa_pairs.output: In the Fan-Out driver, the GUID index is associated with the attribute name "GUID".

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you view the Server object indexes and their state for the Fan-Out driver using iManager?
qa_pairs.output:
To view the Server object indexes and their state for the Fan-Out driver in iManager:
1. Open iManager and navigate to **eDirectory Maintenance > Index Management**.
2. In the Index Management pane, locate and select the **Server** object that corresponds to the Core Driver (the Fan-Out driver).

qa_pairs.instruction: What should you verify before running your first Trawl if the Fan-Out driver indexes may take time to install?
qa_pairs.output: Before running the first Trawl with the Fan-Out driver, verify that all the custom indexes created during installation are in the **online** state. If any index is still offline, wait for it to become online or investigate why it has not finished building.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key points about core driver indexes for the Fan-Out driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Fan-Out driver adds a set of custom value indexes to eDirectory for attributes such as ASAM_* fields, GUID, and standard LDAP attributes (e.g., c, l, ou). These indexes improve attribute lookup performance. Depending on the size of the existing tree, index creation may take time, so you should confirm that all indexes are online before initiating the first Trawl. The indexes can be reviewed in iManager under eDirectory Maintenance > Index Management by selecting the Server object for the Core Driver.
